# dfcloud_flag_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a Dragonfly flag policy by name. Flag policies are created by Dragonfly Cloud operators and can be applied to datastores.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the flag policy to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The timestamp when the flag policy was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the flag policy.
- `flags` (List of String) The Dragonfly flags applied by the policy.
- `id` (String) The ID of the flag policy.
